title: Test Subject #C{Count}

moves.title: Multi-Claw
effects: 3+ hits (hit count increases by 1 each use)

moves.title: Burning Growl
effects: Add 5 Burn cards to player's discard

moves.title: Respawn
effects: Apply power based on respawn count

move_pattern: Phase 1 (HP 111): Cycles Bite → Skull Bash → Bite. On death, revives as Phase 2. Phase 2 (HP 212): Cycles Multi-Claw (hit count increases by 1 each use, starting at 3). On second death, revives as Phase 3. Phase 3 (HP 313): Cycles Lacerate → Big Pounce → Burning Growl → Lacerate.
notes: Test Subject is a three-phase boss with respawning mechanics. It starts with Adaptable Power which grants revives. First form cycles Bite and Skull Bash. When defeated, Respawn triggers (scaling HP for multiplayer), applies Painful Stabs power, and transitions to Phase 2 where Multi-Claw hit count increases by 1 with each use. After the second defeat, revives as Phase 3, applies Nemesis power, removes Adaptable and Painful Stabs powers, and enters a final cycle of high-damage moves. Burning Growl adds Burn status cards to the player's discard pile and applies Strength to the monster itself. The monster progresses through three distinct forms with increasing power and complexity.
